# case: no posts
cd tmp1
exec ssg build
exists build/index.html


# case: no posts with flag (--source)
cd ../tmp2
exec ssg build --source test
exists test/build/index.html


# case: has posts and images
cd ../tmp3
exec ssg build --source test
exists test/build/index.html
exists test/build/posts/k1/p1.html test/build/posts/k1/p2.html test/build/posts/k1/images/1.png
exists test/build/posts/k2/p3.html
! exists test/build/posts/k2/p4.html


# case: recognize 'assets' folder in theme template
cd ../tmp4
exec ssg build --source test
exists test/build/index.html
exists test/build/posts/k1/p1.html test/build/posts/k1/p2.html test/build/posts/k1/images/1.png
exists test/build/posts/k2/p3.html
! exists test/build/posts/k2/p4.html
exists test/build/assets/index.css
exists test/build/assets/post.css


# case: ignore folders in theme template whose names are not 'assets' 
cd ../tmp5
exec ssg build --source test
exists test/build/index.html
! exists test/build/styles/index.css
